name: Flight phase and extremes are kept by the session, not by the dashboard
step: Check the session flight phase and extremes
rationale:
Issue #2344: the run phase and the run extremes (the code keeps the inherited flight names) lived in the dashboard widget, so with the dashboard closed nothing was tracked. lib/flight_stats.lua holds the same phase rules and the same recording, and the session drives it every tick; the dashboard and the ActiveLook widget read the result from the session snapshot.

The harness feeds the module a session-shaped table through a run, a link loss and a reconnect, a second run, a car change, the FC's running latch and the signed throttle (neutral is not a run, reverse is), and checks the recorded min, max, average and motor RPM variance. Against master the module does not exist, so the harness fails.
